name: Oisaki Fumi
source:
Yuuta's big sister. A college student.
She is a heavy drinker, maybe because she is very much like her father. This causes endless quarrels with her mother.
She may look like she is hard to deal with, but in truth she is a serious girl.
She can't help but find her little brother adorable.

[From in-game charater profile]
